script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.lease_owner, (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.request_payload, j.is_deleted,
       (SELECT CAST(MAX(g.id) AS CHAR) FROM stock_adjustment g
         WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND g.sa_v2_job_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.jobId}}' AND g.stock_adjustment_status = 'Processing' AND g.is_deleted = 0
           AND COALESCE((SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
                          WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = (CONCAT('SAC|', CAST(g.id AS CHAR)) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                            AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
                          ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1), j.idempotency_key) = j.idempotency_key) AS linked_sa
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_SPguard.data.jobId}}

       'intransit_qty', CAST(b.intransit_qty AS CHAR), 'organization_id', b.organization_id, 'tenant_id', b.tenant_id,
       'create_user', CAST(b.create_user AS CHAR),
       'create_time', IF(MICROSECOND(b.create_time) = 0, DATE_FORMAT(b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),
                         LEFT(DATE_FORMAT(b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 23)),
       'create_dept', CAST(b.create_dept AS CHAR), 'update_user', CAST(b.update_user AS CHAR),

  FROM item_batch_balance b
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SPids.data.BMID}})

  FROM unit_of_measurement u
 WHERE u.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND u.id IN ({{node:code_node_SPids.data.UID}})
   AND u.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY u.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(t.id AS CHAR), 'batch_number', t.batch_number) AS j
  FROM batch t
 WHERE t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND t.id IN ({{node:code_node_SPids.data.BID}})
   AND t.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY t.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('src', c.src, 'material_id', CAST(c.material_id AS CHAR), 'plant_id', CAST(c.plant_id AS CHAR),
       'batch_id', CAST(c.batch_id AS CHAR), 'cost', CAST(c.cost AS CHAR), 'rn', CAST(c.rn AS CHAR), 'rn_any', CAST(c.rn_any AS CHAR)) AS j
FROM (
  SELECT 'WA' AS src, w.material_id, w.plant_id, w.batch_id, w.wa_cost_price AS cost,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.material_id, w.plant_id, w.batch_id
                            ORDER BY w.create_time DESC, w.id DESC) AS rn,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.material_id, w.plant_id
                            ORDER BY w.create_time DESC, w.id DESC) AS rn_any
  FROM wa_costing_method w
  WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SPids.data.CMID}})
    AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SPids.data.ORG}}'
    AND w.wa_cost_price > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIFO', f.material_id, f.plant_id, f.batch_id, f.fifo_cost_price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.material_id, f.plant_id, f.batch_id
                            ORDER BY CAST(f.fifo_sequence AS UNSIGNED) DESC, f.id DESC),
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.material_id, f.plant_id
                            ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC)
  FROM fifo_costing_history f
  WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_SPids.data.CMID}})
    AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_SPids.data.ORG}}'
    AND f.fifo_cost_price > 0
) c
WHERE c.rn = 1 OR c.rn_any = 1
ORDER BY c.src, c.material_id, c.plant_id, c.batch_id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(r.id AS CHAR), 'rule_name', r.rule_name, 'business_type', r.business_type,
       'department_id', CAST(r.department_id AS CHAR), 'is_default', r.is_default, 'is_draft', r.is_draft, 'tenant_id', r.tenant_id) AS j
  FROM su_code_serial_no_rule r
 WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND r.business_type = 'Stock Adjustment'
   AND r.department_id = {{node:code_node_SPids.data.ORG}}
   AND r.is_default = 1
   AND r.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY r.is_draft, r.id
